title: feat(plugin-detail): every titled field group folds on the default record page
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBS67GdCk8eqw5gt8LmJRet9)_
Fixes #36269

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: semantic
Skills-docs: updated here — `skills/objectstack-data/references/examples-objects.md` (ruling 7074368214 names "any skill text that teaches `'none'` as no toggle" as part of this same change, and the claim's file surface lists it; the seat decides whether a `domain:skills` follow-up is still owed)

## 维护者速读

- 记录页（右侧预览、手机「详情」页、宽屏左侧固定栏、整页）上每个有标题的字段分组现在右侧都有箭头，点标题整行即可收起；原来只有对象声明了可折叠的分组才有。
- 记录页字段区改成一列后页面变长，按您在该卡上的裁决「都能折叠，默认展开」，读者自己收起分组。
- 声明了默认收起的分组照旧先收起，系统信息照旧先收起，表单和设计器预览不变，对象设计器里「折叠」设置的说明文字同步改写；出问题最多是某个分组多了一个箭头，撤回即恢复原样。
- 请审批合并（规范描述文字有改动，按裁决需要您批准）。

## What changes

Maintainer ruling 7074368214 (option (b), 「都能折叠，默认展开」) on the synthesized (default) record page:

- **Renderer** (`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailSection.tsx`, the frameless face). The face drew a disclosure only for a section the synth marked `collapsible` (a group declaring `collapse: 'expanded' | 'collapsed'`), and a plain `h3` heading for `'none'` and for groups declaring nothing. Every titled section on this face now draws the one title-row button (`aria-expanded`, chevron at the right end), whatever its group's `collapse`. `collapse` keeps choosing the first state through the synth's existing `defaultCollapsed` (`'collapsed'` → closed; `'none'` / `'expanded'` → open). The frameless face is only drawn under `DefaultRecordPageContext` (the side preview, the phone 「详情」 tab, the pinned left column and the full page) and never on a print page, so:
  - forms and the designer preview are unchanged (`'none'` = always open, no toggle; they never take the frameless face);
  - the untitled ungrouped bucket draws no toggle (the button is behind `section.title`);
  - a print page still draws every group open with a plain heading (card face);
  - an authored record page keeps its own face (the context is `false` there);
  - 系统信息 (`RecordMetaFooter`) still starts closed (`defaultCollapsed: true`, ruling 7066516044 item 5);
  - the fold is component state, not saved.
- **Spec wording** (`packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts`). The `ObjectFieldGroupSchema.collapse` TSDoc and `.describe()`, and the refusal guidance for a stray `expanded` group key, now say the synthesized record page lets the reader fold every titled group, so there only `'collapsed'` starts closed. The enum, its default and what it accepts are unchanged. Regenerated: `content/docs/references/data/object.mdx`.
- **Heading kept** (L1 S1). The title-row button sits inside the group's `h3` (the disclosure-in-heading pattern), so heading navigation still finds every titled group on the record page.
- **Object form** (`packages/spec/src/data/object.form.ts`, L2 S1). The Collapse help text now says the entry form follows the setting and the default record page lets the reader fold every titled group, so there it only sets the first state; the "None" option reads "always open on the entry form, no toggle". Regenerated: `en.metadata-forms.generated.ts`; the ten translated metadata-form catalogs (ar, de, es-ES, fr, ja-JP, ko, pt-BR, ru, zh-CN, zh-Hant) re-translated for that one key. `@objectstack/platform-objects` gains its changeset line.
- **Docs**: the `collapse` row and the "Groups render identically on forms, modals, and detail pages" sentence (L1 S2) in `content/docs/data-modeling/schema-design.mdx`; the skill reference `skills/objectstack-data/references/examples-objects.md` (it taught the same sentence).
- **ADR-0085 addendum** (`docs/adr/0085-…`): the ruling lists it under "Wording in the same change", and the seat put it in this PR (claim amendment 7120248008). It records the record-page fold against §4 and §5 and states that every other surface keeps §4 as written.
- No app change (CRM, HotCRM add nothing), per ruling item 4.

**Metadata-protocol: semantic.** On the synthesized record page `collapse: 'none'` no longer means "no toggle"; it means "starts open", the same as `'expanded'`. What to check in an app: an object that used `'none'` to keep a group from folding on the record page now shows a chevron there; forms keep it always open. **Clause-②: no**, measured: no accepted value, key, default or exported type changes (`check:api-surface` and `check:authorable-surface` green on the head below).

## Tests

- `DetailSection.fieldList-36147.test.tsx`, new describe "every titled group folds on the record page; `collapse` picks the first state": a group declaring nothing folds from its title row starting open (chevron up → down, rows unmount); the same on the width-laid page (cap 3); `'collapsed'` starts closed; the untitled bucket has no toggle; control: off the record page a `'none'` group keeps a plain heading. The existing empty-rows case now asserts the group's one fold beside the list's empty-fields row.
- `defaultFieldGroupsPage.sectionHeadings.test.tsx`, new describe across the seam (synth → `record:details` → `DetailSection` under `DefaultRecordPageContext`): groups declaring nothing each fold, starting open, and the untitled bucket has none; `'collapsed'` starts closed and `'none'` open; control: the same page off the record page draws no disclosure.
- Updated to the ruled behaviour: `recordPageV3Face-27055.test.tsx` (a `'none'` section folds, starting open, and its heading holds the toggle: both roles pinned), `RecordDetailView.accessibleNames-12625.test.tsx` (the non-collapsible group is now a button, open), `headerColor.test.ts` (three `headerColorClass` call sites, the frameless face has one title row).
- The cross-seam case in `defaultFieldGroupsPage.sectionHeadings.test.tsx` also pins that each group's heading holds its fold.

## Acceptance notes

- **The four faces, live** (CRM dev boot, an object seeded with four groups: no `collapse`, `'none'`, `'expanded'`, `'collapsed'`): each face reads `Summary=open, Contact (none)=open, Terms (expanded)=open, Notes (collapsed)=closed, Other=open, System information=closed` (the `aria-expanded` of each title-row button), in zh-CN and en; clicking the `'none'` group's title folds it. Faces: full page at 700 px (details as the first tab), pinned left column at 1680 px (`data-record-page-pinned`), side preview, phone 390 px 「详情」 tab. Screenshots were taken at head; they are attached to the project thread, not committed.
- **Outside the first claim surface** (claim amended 7120248008): the existing app-shell test `RecordDetailView.accessibleNames-12625.test.tsx` (its "non-collapsible group is no button" control now reads a button, open), `skills/objectstack-data/references/examples-objects.md` (kept here by the seat), `object.form.ts` with the metadata-form catalogs, and `docs/adr/0085`.
- **The "Other" group folds too.** The running app titles the ungrouped bucket of a grouped object ("Other" / 「其他」), so it is a titled group and folds; only a section drawn with no title has no toggle. This is the ruling's "every titled group"; worth knowing at approval.
- **Translations.** The metadata-form catalogs carry no source hashes for this key, so a stale translation would be served silently; all ten translated values were rewritten from the new English, keeping each locale's existing ending for "Unset: none".
- **The designer hint** for this setting already reads 「控制该分组在真实表单（预览）中的折叠方式」 (ruling analysis), so no Studio copy changes.

## Verification

Read first (by risk): `DetailSection.tsx` frameless face (the `section.title &&` title-row button that replaced the `collapsible` split), `object.zod.ts` `collapse` `.describe()`, `RecordMetaFooter.tsx` (unchanged; 系统信息 still `defaultCollapsed: true`).

Two-minute check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/defaultFieldGroupsPage.sectionHeadings.test.tsx` — expect every case green, including "groups that declare no `collapse` each fold from their title, starting open".
